gust.meaning: 돌개바람 (active) — a small whirlwind summoned at a spot that drags nearby enemies into its centre and nicks them.
gust.A: Doho in three-quarter view flings a yellow talisman forward; just ahead of him a compact, tight grey ink whirlwind spins on the ground, dust and torn leaves curving INWARD toward its eye. The whirlwind is the dominant shape; Doho is secondary on one side.
gust.B: No figure. A single compact spiral funnel of grey-charcoal ink filling the icon, dust and debris streaks all curving inward to the centre, a tiny yellow talisman fluttering at the eye of the spiral. Strong inward-pull read.

shower.meaning: 소나기 (active) — a rain field on the ground that soaks enemies (wet status). No damage.
shower.A: Doho raises a yellow talisman toward a low dark cloud; a dense slanted sheet of rain falls onto a round patch of ground in front of him, puddle rings on that patch with an indigo-teal water sheen.
shower.B: No figure. A heavy low cloud at the top, straight slanted rain lines falling onto a round ground patch below covered in ripple rings and indigo-teal water sheen. Clear 'rain zone' read.

wet_sky.meaning: 젖은 하늘 (passive) — lightning jumps more readily between soaked enemies.
wet_sky.A: Dark rain cloud above; one ivory-white lightning bolt forks into three branches, each landing on a separate rain-soaked ground puddle ring with indigo-teal sheen. Compact passive motif, no Doho.
wet_sky.B: A single big raindrop shape in indigo-teal ink with a thin ivory-white lightning crack branching inside it. Very simple, one emblem.

fog.meaning: 짙은 안개 (active) — a fog bank where enemies miss and Doho cannot be seen from afar.
fog.A: Doho's gat and shoulders half-dissolved in thick low grey mist bands; only the hat brim, one eye area and the red sash show through. A dark enemy claw swipes through empty mist beside him, missing.
fog.B: No full figure. Layered horizontal bands of thick grey mist fill the icon, a faint ghostly dark silhouette barely visible inside, one black arrow passing harmlessly through the mist. Soft but high-contrast banding.

sky_qi.meaning: 하늘 기운 (passive) — summoned weather spreads wider and lasts longer.
sky_qi.A: A small yellow talisman at the centre with a wide storm-cloud ring spreading outward from it in widening concentric bands of cloud and rain, the outer band reaching the icon edges. No Doho.
sky_qi.B: Top of the icon: a broad storm canopy of charcoal cloud stretching edge to edge over a small horizon line, rain veils hanging from it; a tiny talisman at the canopy's centre. Emphasises breadth.

waterspout.meaning: 용오름 (active) — a large tornado that walks slowly toward the cursor, sucking enemies into it.
waterspout.A: A towering twisted waterspout column (dragon-rising, 용오름) striding across the ground, debris spiralling up it, a faint dragon-coil shape suggested in the cloud at its top; Doho small at its foot pointing it forward.
waterspout.B: No figure. One tall S-curved funnel of charcoal and indigo-teal ink from cloud to ground, debris spiralling upward, the cloud top coiled like a dragon's body. Tall vertical read, distinct from a small whirlwind.

storm_call.meaning: 호풍환우 (ultimate) — a great storm surrounds Doho; everything inside is soaked and lightning falls on its own.
storm_call.A: Doho at centre holding a yellow talisman high overhead, a huge circular storm of wind and rain swirling around him, three ivory-white lightning bolts striking the ground around the ring. Dramatic, the most powerful of the storm icons.
storm_call.B: Eye-of-the-storm view: a large swirling ring of black cloud and rain around a calm centre where a tiny Doho silhouette stands, several ivory-white lightning bolts dropping at the rim of the ring.

paper_soldier.meaning: 종이 병사 (active) — a thrown paper-doll talisman becomes a sword-carrying paper soldier that chases and cuts enemies.
paper_soldier.A: A cut-paper hanji soldier figure unfolding upright out of a thrown talisman: folded paper chest armour, small Joseon jeollip soldier hat, a straight hwando sword in hand, vermilion marks on its body; Doho's hand releasing it from one corner.
paper_soldier.B: Close-up of a single cut-paper hanji soldier standing in guard with a straight sword, crisp folded paper edges, small jeollip hat, vermilion talisman marks on the chest. Paper-doll silhouette, no human skin.

scarecrow.meaning: 허수아비 (active) — a paper scarecrow decoy that all nearby enemies attack; when broken it bursts and briefly binds them.
scarecrow.A: A paper-and-straw scarecrow on a pole, plastered with yellow talismans, arms out, standing at centre; several dark enemy silhouettes at the edges all turned toward it.
scarecrow.B: A paper scarecrow mid-burst: its paper body tearing into scraps and short black ink chain links flying outward in a ring. Clear burst read.

paper_mastery.meaning: 종이 숙련 (passive) — paper constructs become tougher and sharper.
paper_mastery.A: Two fingers of Doho holding a single taut folded hanji sheet like a blade, its edge crisp and sharp as steel, vermilion seal mark on it. Compact passive emblem.
paper_mastery.B: A stack of layered folded hanji paper armour scales overlapping like a tough shield, crisp edges, one vermilion seal mark. Single emblem.

binding_talisman.meaning: 속박부 (active) — a talisman stabbed into the ground; a moment later nearby enemies are bound by black ink chains.
binding_talisman.A: Doho's hand driving a yellow talisman down into the ground; thick black ink chains burst out from it in several directions across the ground.
binding_talisman.B: No figure. A yellow talisman stuck upright in the ground at the centre, thick black ink chains coiling out from it in a full ring. Strong circular bind read.

exorcist_qi.meaning: 퇴마 기운 (passive) — every bound demon adds weight to Doho's next sword blow.
exorcist_qi.A: Doho's straight sword held point-up, its blade wrapped by stacked black ink chain rings and a small yellow talisman, heavy and charged; faint chained ghost silhouettes in the dark background.
exorcist_qi.B: A sword blade seen close up with several stacked chain rings sliding down it like weights, a yellow talisman tied at the hilt. Single emblem.

shadow_blade.meaning: 그림자 칼 (passive) — the first blow from hiding is a guaranteed deadly critical.
shadow_blade.A: Doho lunging blade-first out of a pool of black ink shadow, only the sword edge and the gat brim catching cold light, red sash flicking behind. Ambush read.
shadow_blade.B: No full figure. A straight sword thrusting out of solid black ink, only its edge lit, a single dull-red sash ribbon trailing from the darkness.

summon_general.meaning: 신장 부르기 (ultimate) — summons a giant paper divine general (神將) that fights beside Doho and slams the ground.
summon_general.A: A towering hanji-paper divine general in Joseon-style layered paper armour with a large paper glaive, looming behind a small Doho; vermilion talisman marks on its chest. The most powerful of the paper icons.
summon_general.B: A giant paper fist / glaive of the paper general slamming the ground, shockwave ring of paper scraps flying outward. Huge scale read.
